description: A narrow site footer with a breadcrumb, a collapsible link directory, and legal lines.
overview: A narrow footer for mobile-first sites: a breadcrumb for the current page, a collapsible directory of link sections and legal lines at the bottom. It keeps the same single-column layout at every width. As a server component with no state, it drops into any layout.
usage: Edit `sections` for the directory titles and links. URLs are hash anchors generated by the `slug` helper, so map them to your real routes. The breadcrumb trail, phone number, copyright and region link are inline.
